Audit event kinds may contain inconsistent whitespace and casing. Add the public audit.NormalizeKind(kind string) string function in audit/normalize.go to remove surrounding whitespace and lowercase the kind. Preserve the module metadata and tests, and leave the workspace verified. Do not use semantic editing MCP tools; use standard file editing. When done, output DONE.

runs.before_state:
// Package audit leaves room for normalization rules owned by the delivery boundary.
package audit

observed: /bin/zsh -lc "cat audit/normalize.go; sed -n '1,240p' service/dispatch.go; sed -n '1,220p' audit/event.go; rg -n \"probe|health|record\\(\" .
/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && cat audit/normalize.go && sed -n '1,240p' service/dispatch.go && sed -n '1,220p' audit/event.go && rg -n \"probe|health|record\\(\" .

/bin/zsh -lc "go version; go env goroot gotoolchain gocache; sha256sum go.mod go.sum; gofmt -d audit/normalize.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go; cat audit/normalize.go; cat audit/summary.go; sed -n '8,20p' service/dispatch.go; rg --files -g 'go.sum' -g 'go.mod' .

/bin/zsh -lc "gofmt -w audit/normalize.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go && go test ./... && sha256sum go.mod && rg -n \"func normalizekind|func \\(d \\*dispatcher\\) record|switch normalizekind|case \\\"health\\\", \\\"probe\\\"\" audit service && git diff -- audit/normalize.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go go.mod go.sum

/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g 'agents.md' -g 'project_brief.md' -g 'readme*' -g 'makefile' -g 'go.work' .; cat audit/summary.go; cat audit/summary_test.go; cat service/dispatch_test.go; cat metrics/writer.go; cat legacy/export.go; cat go.mod; ls -la
